Hi Maya — thanks for the clear list. I've outlined a pragmatic starter-pack and a two-step discount pathway below to keep procurement moving. Attaching a short workbook with line-item costing.

Summary (starter pack for 30M tokens/month pilot):
- Base hosted inference: standard per-token rate (we'll show final numbers in workbook).
- Compliance Starter Pack (one-time onboarding + monthly): includes 90d audit-log retention (ingest + retention), KMS integration (customer KMS via envelope encryption), and HIPAA evidence bundle (cert checklists, sample config snippets, attestation letter).
- EU residency toggle: treated as regional routing + dedicated EU cache; priced as a 15% premium on pilot throughput for partial residency (up to 20% of traffic).

Discount pathway (if move to GA within 6 months):
- Expansion threshold A (>=200M tokens/mo): 10% on platform usage + 50% credit amortization on one-time onboarding for Compliance Starter Pack.
- Expansion threshold B (>=750M tokens/mo OR 12 month committed Dedicated pool): 20% on platform usage + 100% onboarding credit (absorbed over first 6 invoices) + reduced per-seat HSM/KMS fee.

Notes / clarifications:
- HSM: we price HSM seat-based access separately (monthly seat license) if customer wants Redwood-managed HSM. If Healnex brings its own HSM/KMS and we integrate (bring-your-own-key), that is included in the Starter Pack onboarding (no HSM seat fees).
- Audit logs: export to customer S3 is included for pilot; extended retention beyond 90d is add-on.
- Evidence: HIPAA evidence bundle is included in Starter Pack; SOC2 report references are available under NDA if required (we usually share SOC2 Type II summary under an NDA).

Attached: Healnex_Compliance_StarterPack_v1.xlsx — line-item pilot pricing, expansion math, and an implementation milestone schedule.

Next steps: if this looks directionally correct I suggest we (1) lock a pilot quote, (2) agree an MA/MP (mutual action plan) with a target GA date, and (3) get a short statement of work for the onboarding tasks.

Looping Ben who will note the procurement cadence and exceptions we typically offer for pilot to GA transitions.

Thanks,

Hi Maya — quick operational clarifications from pricing ops:

1) KMS vs HSM: as Irene noted, BYOK KMS integrations are included (we support AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, and an HSM gateway). If Healnex needs Redwood-managed HSM seats (for dedicated FIPS boundary), those are a separate monthly seat fee; for pilot we typically waive first-month seat fees if customer signs a 12-month committed Dedicated pool at GA.

2) EU partial residency: our routing model allows percentage-based residency routing; for the pilot price we can cap the add-on to a flat uplift of $6,500/month (instead of % uplift) to simplify procurement. That cap is valid if EU traffic stays <25% in month 2.

3) Discounting mechanics: onboarding credits are amortized as invoice credits (not lump-sum rebates) and visible on the invoice as "Compliance Onboarding Credit". To secure the higher threshold (Expansion B) we require a signed commitment (order form) that includes either token minimums or a Dedicated cluster commitment.

If you want I'll convert the workbook to a one-page quote with the pilot fixed numbers and the conditional expansion credits called out.

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Pricing & Packaging, Redwood Inference
